plan.diagnosis_summary: node_2 has three fixable faults: residual schema aliases replacing missing canonical dur/rate/sjit, a factor-of-8 bytes-vs-bits scale drift (primary conservation ratio 0.125 with violation_rate 1.0 on both byte laws, sbytes/dbytes ratios 0.125, sload 0.1877, dload 0.1221), and 406 corrupted rows. probe_qos_hint is a global metadata column that acts as a label shortcut only on node_4 (mi_norm 1.0002 vs peer max 0.0053, robust_z 49.85) and must be dropped; after excluding it, only node_4 shows clearly elevated label noise (suspected_noise_rate 0.2219, high_conf_conflict_rate 0.1269, mean_self_confidence 0.4343 vs peer 0.041-0.045 / 0.023-0.024 / 0.819). node_1 is clean and node_3 is a legitimate rare-class Non-IID node with consistent primary conservation (ratio 1.0) and clean rows.

With probe_qos_hint excluded: suspected_noise_rate 0.2219, high_conf_conflict_rate 0.1269, mean_self_confidence 0.4343, cv_macro_f1 0.4598 vs peers ~0.041-0.045, 0.023-0.024, 0.819, 0.712-0.719.
Clean rows, primary conservation ratio 1.0, no missing canonicals, noise rate 0.0445 and self-confidence 0.819 matching healthy baseline.
